title: VPC Flow Logs: who talked to whom

kcs.statement: VPC Flow Logs record metadata about IP traffic to and from network interfaces in a VPC (source, destination, port, accepted or rejected), for troubleshooting connectivity and security analysis; they do not capture packet contents.

problem_ideas: An app cannot reach its database and you suspect a firewall rule: which log shows REJECT records?
True or false: Flow Logs let you read the HTTP request bodies of your users
A security team wants to see which IPs connected to an instance last night: pick the feature
Distinguish Flow Logs from API-call logging: who changed a security group vs which packets were rejected
Flow Logs can be captured at three levels: VPC, subnet, network interface; which gives the narrowest view?
A flow log line shows ACCEPT inbound but REJECT outbound for the same connection: which firewall type is likely misconfigured?
